capital.evidence_quote: Castries is the capital city and main commercial seaport of Saint Lucia

currency.evidence_quote: The Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD, EC$) is pegged to USD at 2.70 XCD = 1 USD; USD is widely accepted

timezone.evidence_quote: Saint Lucia operates on Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential single-phase electricity across Saint Lucia is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electric power grid operates at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: British standard Type G rectangular three-pin plugs and wall sockets are universal across Saint Lucia

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for emergency police assistance throughout Saint Lucia

sources.title: Saint Lucia Fire and Ambulance Service

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 for emergency medical services and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency fire and rescue services

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Special Operations and Tourist Police Units patrol Rodney Bay and Soufrière at +1 758 456 3865

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Saint Lucia reach approximately 38.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Saint Lucia measure 72.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel and Flow offer 4G tourist SIMs at Hewanorra International Airport (UVF) in the south and George F.L. Charles Airport (SLU) near Castries. Travelers must complete the digital immigration card at stlucia.org/enter before boarding.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: All visitors must submit the official digital Saint Lucia Immigration and Customs form prior to arrival

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 61%) and Protestantism (approx. 25%) with rich Anglo-French Creole traditions

sources.title: The Central Statistical Office of Saint Lucia

religion.evidence_quote: Catholicism is the predominant faith; Saint Lucian French Creole (Kwéyòl) is spoken universally alongside English

festivals.value: Saint Lucia Jazz & Arts Festival in May, Saint Lucia Carnival in July, Jounen Kwéyòl (Creole Heritage Day in October)
festivals.evidence_quote: Saint Lucia Jazz & Arts Festival is the Caribbean's premier musical and cultural gathering

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage clothing of any color or style is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists under Saint Lucian law. Do not touch or harvest sea turtle eggs. British three-pin Type G plugs are standard; bring adapters for European or American appliances.

sources.title: Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Legal Bulletin

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Civilian possession or wearing of camouflage material is prohibited by statute

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included on restaurant and hotel bills; leaving an extra 5-10% in cash for staff is appreciated.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service charge is standard in restaurants and hospitality bills
